question: Goswami Tulsidas who composed Ramcharitmanas was born in the modern state of ________.
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Uttar Pradesh.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Goswami Tulsidas **was born In modern **Uttar Pradesh**.
 
• He wrote several popular works in **Sanskrit and Awadhi.**
 
• But is best known as the author of the **Hanuman Chalisa **and of the grand **Ramcharitmanas,** a retelling of the **Sanskrit Ramayana **grounded on Rama's life in the conversational **Awadhi.**
 
• **Tulsidas **spent the utmost of his life in the megacity of **Varanasi and Ayodhya.**
 
• The **Tulsi Ghat** on the **Ganges River** in **Varanasi** is named after him.
 
• He has been accredited as one of the topmost muses in **Hindi, Indian, and World Literature.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• ** Ramcharitmanas** is a grand lyric in the **Awadhi language**, **composed by the 16th- century** Indian bhakti minstrel Tulsidas.
 
• It's considered one of the topmost workshops of** Hindu literature.**
 
• The word **Ramcharitmanas** literally means" **Lake of the deeds of Rama"**.
 
• The jotting of **Ramcharitmanas also heralded numerous artistic traditions.**
 
• Most significantly that of the tradition of **Ramlila, **the dramatic enactment of the textbook. **Ramcharitmanas is considered by numerous as a work belonging to the Saguna academy.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**
